rehearsal.pageIntro: Test your setup privately before going live. A rehearsal uses your normal stream key and runs the real ingest, transcoding, health checks and chat filters, but only you and up to five followers you invite can see it. Nothing about it counts as a broadcast.
rehearsal.loadFailed: The rehearsal could not be loaded.
rehearsal.status.title: Rehearsal
rehearsal.armHint: Once armed, your next publish with the normal stream key within 10 minutes starts a private rehearsal instead of going live. A rehearsal ends after 30 minutes.
rehearsal.armFailed: The rehearsal could not be armed.
rehearsal.refusal.live: End your live stream before rehearsing.
rehearsal.disarmBody: Your encoder is disconnected and refused for two minutes. A publish after that goes live.
rehearsal.disarmArmedBody: Your next publish goes live instead of starting a rehearsal.
rehearsal.disarmFailed: The rehearsal could not be ended.
rehearsal.key.title: Stream key
rehearsal.key.reminder: Stream with your normal key (the one starting {prefix}). It is never shown here in full.
rehearsal.key.none: You have no stream key yet.
rehearsal.invitees.title: Invitees
rehearsal.invitees.hint: Up to {max} of your followers can watch, signed in. Every change is recorded.
rehearsal.invitees.label: Follower username
rehearsal.invitees.inputHint: Only followers of your channel can be invited.
rehearsal.invitees.limit: A rehearsal has at most {max} invitees.
rehearsal.invitees.emptyHint: Only you can watch until you invite a follower.
rehearsal.invitees.notArmed: Arm a rehearsal to invite followers.
rehearsal.invitees.notFollower: Only signed-in followers of your channel can be invited.
rehearsal.invitees.failed: The invitee list could not be changed.
rehearsal.checklist.title: Checklist
rehearsal.checklist.hint: Updated every 5 seconds while the rehearsal runs.
rehearsal.player.title: Rehearsal player
rehearsal.player.waiting: Nothing to show yet. Start streaming to see the rehearsal here.

rehearsal.report.chat.title: Simulated chat
